one_line: Founder-king of the Manikya line who reshaped 15th-century Tripura on the Bengal frontier.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early-40s, medium height, wiry yet regal build with a commander’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp jawline and high cheekbones; medium brown North-East Indian complexion; thin arched eyebrows, focused dark eyes with a determined, slightly severe default expression that softens into a measured courtly calm.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head, front kept smooth with a center part; he wears a modest gold-embroidered red cloth turban (pagri) wrapped close to the skull with a narrow band, set slightly back to reveal the hairline, and a small central gold leaf-shaped ornament pinned above the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length, front-wrapped cotton anga/kurta in muted cream, with a narrow stand collar and subtle vertical weaving stripes, over which sits a rich deep-red silk patka-style sash wrapped diagonally from left shoulder to right hip and tied there with one short end hanging; the lower garment is a dark indigo-blue, tightly wrapped dhoti-style cloth with neat pleats in front and a border band of muted gold, reaching to the ankles; over his shoulders is a lightweight forest-green cotton uttariya shawl with a thin mustard border, usually draped around both shoulders and falling evenly; his feet are in brown leather mojaris with slightly upturned toes, and he wears restrained jewellery—a single gold stud in each ear, a simple flat gold torque-style necklace close to the neck, one plain gold ring on his right hand, and a narrow engraved copper bangle on his left wrist.
appearance.signature: A sheathed straight single-edged sword modeled on late-medieval eastern Indian blades, with a plain iron hilt and a gently flared pommel, worn at his left hip in a dark-brown leather scabbard adorned with a small circular coin-like brass medallion embossed with a tiny lotus motif to echo his coinage.

ref_desc: Ratna Manikya I is a wiry mid-30s king with medium-brown oval face, intense dark eyes, black hair in a low knot under a red gold-trimmed turban, wearing a cream anga, red patka, indigo dhoti, green shawl, modest gold jewellery, and a coin-ornamented sword at his left hip in cream, deep red, indigo blue, forest green and muted gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Ratna Manikya I, a wiry mid-30s Tripura king with a medium-brown oval face, sharp jawline, intense dark eyes and a calm yet stern expression, his thick black hair pulled into a low knot under a close-wrapped red cloth turban trimmed with subtle gold and a small central gold leaf ornament. Show him in a cream knee-length anga/kurta with a narrow stand collar and faint vertical weave texture, over which a deep-red silk patka-style sash runs from left shoulder to right hip, tied there with a short end hanging. His lower garment is a dark indigo-blue ankle-length dhoti, tightly wrapped with neat frontal pleats and a muted gold border, and he has a lightweight forest-green cotton shawl with a thin mustard border draped symmetrically over both shoulders. Put brown leather mojaris with slightly upturned toes on his feet, a simple flat gold torque necklace, small gold studs in both ears, one plain gold ring on his right hand, and a narrow engraved copper bangle on his left wrist. At his left hip, attach a straight single-edged sword in a dark-brown leather scabbard, the plain iron hilt partially visible and the scabbard decorated with a small round brass medallion resembling a coin with a lotus motif, emphasizing his role as a coin-issuing ruler. Use a palette dominated by cream, deep red, indigo blue, forest green and muted gold, and present him from multiple angles with clear views of face, hair, costume details and the sword so the design can be consistently redrawn.
